record.body:
## Description

Prove the quiet-header exit criteria together, through the dashboard tests and `dashboard/bin/dashboard --once`, after header-chrome has landed.

## Approach

Run each acceptance verify command from the phase worktree. Do not edit `.artifacts/`. If a command fails, fix the dashboard or its tests in the worktree and re-run that command. The `--once` criterion must go through `dashboard/bin/dashboard --once`, which the `once_tally` test already launches. The last criterion is the full suite: non-tmux tests in parallel, then the tmux tests alone.

payload.title: Verify quiet status tabs and a collapsed phase stepper
